what: Verse reads its own red GitHub Actions runs by itself (asked by Verse): when a workflow that tests main fails, actions-failures.yml reads the run with its own GITHUB_TOKEN and keeps each failed job, the step that failed, the lines that name what failed and that step's last 30 lines, keys masked, beside the incidents; the incident autopsy shows them. For commit 814032d5 (Verse verify run 41264790432) it found four failed jobs: python-tests, browser-suite (1), (2) and (3); python-tests failed at step 4 (The fast tests), whose last 30 lines end on tools/verse-loop.test.mjs 'not ok 10 - negative controls' (20 of 21 passed, exit code 1)
asked: Automate the extraction of failing job names and error logs from GitHub Actions for commit 814032d5.
